title: Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions — Utility Bill Tracking and Dashboard Access by Tier

# Utility Bill Tracking and Dashboard Access by Tier

Feature matrix for the bill tracking and dashboard entitlements of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions. A subscription's tier decides how many utility billing accounts are tracked, how often bills are captured, whether billing errors are pursued, how many named users see the dashboard, and how data is made available.

| Tier | Utility billing accounts tracked | Bill capture frequency | Utility billing errors pursued on the owner's behalf | Named dashboard users included | Annual fee per dashboard user beyond the included users (USD per user per year) | Data access through the reporting interface | Full data export when the subscription ends |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Utility Bill Tracking Subscription | 3 | monthly | no | 2 | 180 | no | yes |
| Metering & Dashboard Subscription | 5 | monthly | no | 5 | 165 | no | yes |
| Energy Analytics Subscription | 10 | monthly | yes | 10 | 150 | yes | yes |
| Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription | 15 | monthly | yes | 20 | 140 | yes | yes |
| Measurement & Verification Program | 25 | monthly | yes | 30 | 130 | yes | yes |
| Managed Energy Performance Program | 60 | monthly | yes | 75 | 115 | yes | yes |


## Points of judgement

**Which accounts are tracked.** The count is a number of utility billing accounts, not a number of buildings or meters; a Metering & Dashboard Subscription tracks up to 5 billing accounts at the building.

**Capture frequency.** Bills are captured monthly at every tier; no tier captures quarterly and no tier leaves bills uncaptured.

**Error recovery.** Pursuing a utility billing error on the owner's behalf is an entitlement of the Energy Analytics Subscription and every tier above it. The two lower tiers track the bills without pursuing errors.

**Dashboard users.** The included figure is a count of named users. A user beyond it carries the tier's annual per-user fee: a Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription with 22 named users, for illustration, has 2 users beyond its 20 included, each at USD 140 a year.

**Interface access and export.** Access through the reporting interface begins at the Energy Analytics Subscription. Every tier, including the Utility Bill Tracking Subscription, provides the full data export at the end of the subscription.
